report.root_cause: AuditTrail plugin config (plugins/AuditTrail/config.yml) was changed to debug: true at ~07:31:13 and hot-reloaded at 07:31:15. That turned on packet-level TRACE logging to plugins/AuditTrail/debug/trace-N.log, which wrote about 3 MB/s (about 125 MB in under a minute) and was filling the server volume.
report.actions: 1) Watched status and saw disk jump from 23 MB to 113 MB. 2) Used du to find the source in plugins/AuditTrail/debug/trace-*.log. 3) Declared the incident. 4) Read the AuditTrail config (debug: true) and the latest.log reload line (debug=true at 07:31:15). 5) Rewrote plugins/AuditTrail/config.yml with debug: false (retention-days: 30 unchanged). The plugin auto-reloaded with debug=false at 07:31:47. 6) Confirmed the trace files stopped growing. 7) Deleted the runaway debug trace files trace-0.log, trace-1.log and trace-2.log (about 125 MB). Did not touch audit.log. 8) Confirmed disk back to 23 MB (5%) and stable, TPS 20, both players online. No restart, no bans.
report.residual_risk: If someone turns AuditTrail debug back on, the volume will fill again, because the trace logs have no size cap or rotation limit. Whoever enabled debug should be told, and a size cap on debug traces is recommended.
